# MatrixQR

> MatrixQR is a free, client-side QR code generator. Create WiFi and vCard QR codes instantly with a premium tech aesthetic. No data tracking, works offline.

## Overview

- [Official Website](https://www.matrixqr.cc/): Canonical site for MatrixQR Studio (Free, $0.00).
- [Execution Model](https://www.matrixqr.cc/about): 100% Client-Side JS, Zero Server Storage, GDPR Ready.
- [Last Updated](https://www.matrixqr.cc/): 2026-09-16.

## Key Pages

- [MatrixQR Studio](https://www.matrixqr.cc/): Secure client-side QR code generator supporting URL, WiFi, and vCard modes.
- [Free Digital Menu QR Code Generator](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Dedicated tool for generating digital menu QR codes with custom branding.
- [MatrixBlog](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/): Official blog, technical updates, and user guides.
- [Privacy Policy](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/privacy-policy): Privacy commitments and zero-data-collection policy details.
- [MatrixQR About](https://www.matrixqr.cc/about): Why we started this project and our engineering principles.

## Why MatrixQR

- [Offline QR Code Generator](https://www.matrixqr.cc/): A rare mainstream QR generator running entirely in-browser with zero server-side logging—ideal for WiFi credentials and contact data.

## Key Features & Capabilities

- [Supported Modules](https://www.matrixqr.cc/): Website URL QR, WiFi Network QR (SSID/Password), and vCard Contact QR.
- [Privacy & Security](https://www.matrixqr.cc/about): Pure client-side processing via JavaScript. No user data, passwords, or logs transmitted to any server.
- [Offline Capable](https://www.matrixqr.cc/): Fully functional without active internet connection after initial page load.
- [Export Options](https://www.matrixqr.cc/): Supports clean, watermark-free high-resolution PNG exports.

## Disambiguation

- [Canonical Name](https://www.matrixqr.cc/): MatrixQR.
- [Scope](https://www.matrixqr.cc/about): Refers strictly to the privacy-first web utility suite at matrixqr.cc and its subdomains. Not affiliated with unrelated software/hardware sharing similar naming.
